title: Genesis 22:2 — first use of “love” (ahava, אהבה): the Law of First Usage
summary: Genesis 22:2 in English and Hebrew, where God tells Abraham to take his only son Isaac, whom he loves, and offer him on Mount Moriah. The word love (ahava, אהבה) is highlighted in magenta as the first time love appears in the Bible — the “Law of 1st Usage” — tied to a father offering his only son.

text.text: 2 And God said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you love, Isaac and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you.”
2 ויאמר קח נא את בנך את יחידך אשר אהבת את יצחק ולך לך אל ארץ המריה והעלהו שם לעלה על אחד ההרים אשר אמר אליך׃
